limitations: Structural coverage only; constants, interactions and T/P validity require source-specific review
Species presence does not establish completeness; neutral CO2 and complex activity conventions matter
Missing explicit -Vm or temperature coefficients do not establish a valid zero correction
INCLUDE$ dependencies are not resolved by this text audit
Database calibration lineage versus experiments remains incompletely documented

holdout_qualification: pending_calibration_lineage; external experimental prediction comparison only, no strict independent-parameter holdout certification

controls.interpretation: one-at-a-time stated controls, not joint confidence interval or residual minimization

excluded: 278.15 K and 288.15 K: below existing endpoint API 23 C lower limit
all MEG/salt mixtures: outside pure-water contract
2022 thesis values: related source, not identical to 2025 table and not a second independent replicate
author-fitted Pitzer/OLI/correlation curves: not independent measurements
model_protocol.holdout_qualification: pending_calibration_lineage; external experimental prediction comparison only, no strict independent-parameter holdout certification
model_protocol.independent_of_database_calibration: UNKNOWN; relevant parameters changed after underlying 2022 data existed
model_protocol.measured_observable: AAS total dissolved Ca as CaCO3-equivalent molality; multiply mmol/kg by 1e-3 for mol/kg water

model.activity_model: unchanged ion-association, WATEQ/default gamma and CO2 dimer profile
model.aqueous_pressure: pCO2 + 0.0317 bar water-vapor approximation at 25 C, explicit control omits this term; not an experimental measurement
model.gas_boundary: fixed_CO2_partial_pressure, native Peng-Robinson; pressure tank supports approximation
model.initial_recipe: type-1 deionized water approximated as pure water, no added salts/MEG
model.software: MineralTrace frozen source hashes; PHREEQC executable hash recorded in freeze receipt
model.stock_interpretation: numerical normalization/buffering only, not guessed experimental solvent or solid amount; excess solid reported, exact per-run masses unknown

model_protocol.model_basis: PHREEQC total aqueous Ca moles divided by calculated mass_H2O; not free-ion activity or initial water mass
model_protocol.outcome_policy: Report all signed discrepancies, MSE/MAE/RMSE/max relative error and signs; no model ranking, tuning, pass threshold or Gaussian/weighted statistical validation
model_protocol.protocol_stage: frozen before first MineralTrace prediction for this dataset
model_protocol.reported_duplicate_sd: Table 3 column sigma: standard deviation of duplicate data; retain separate from standard uncertainty
model_protocol.reported_standard_uncertainty: Table 3 footnote a: u(T)=0.05 K, u(P)=2.7 kPa, u(m)=0.15 mmol/kg; do not combine duplicate SD with u(m) without covariance model
model_protocol.selection: All five 298.15 K, pure-water Table 3 measurements, ordered by increasing pressure; no prediction-dependent selection

unmeasured.operational_gas_history: UNKNOWN; fixed-pressure reservoir is a documented approximation, not exact experiment replay
unmeasured.pH: UNKNOWN measured endpoint; author's pressure-pH correlation is derived and excluded from validation
